name: core-js
readme_excerpt: Welcome to our new website, core-js.io, where our documentation is moving! I highly recommend reading this: So, what's next? > Modular standard library for JavaScript. Includes polyfills for ECMAScript up to 2025: promises, symbols, collections, iterators, typed arrays, many other features, ECMAScript proposals, some cross-platform WHATWG / W3C features and proposals like URL. You can load only required features or use it without global namespace pollution. core-js@3, babel and a look into the…
